attempts.rationale: The series has strong seasonality and unstable model rankings across windows, which makes weighted combinations risky due to overfitting on recent noise. A robust median combination of the full pool is a safe baseline that mitigates outlier errors from individual models.

The series has strong seasonality and low predictability with unstable rankings (trend strength 0.84, ranking tau 0.025). Since median performed well by being robust to outliers and instability, a simple unweighted mean over the full pool is the logical next baseline to test if equal weighting helps average out the correlated errors in this noisy regime.
